generation.prompt:
Generate a 2x4 grid of 8 minimalist grayscale monochrome icons on transparent background (PNG), flat design, black/gray colors only:
1. Browser app icon (outline window + globe)
2. Text/code editor icon (outline document + cursor)
3. Music player icon (outline note)
4. Launch/run cursor icon (mouse cursor + small play triangle)
5. Warning/high-load gauge icon (dial condong ke kanan, tanpa angka/teks)
6. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]
7. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]
8. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style: flat design, black/gray colors only, transparent background, grid 2 rows x 4 columns, no text/labels baked into image.
